Our client is a global leader in integrated real estate and facility management services, supporting large corporate and industrial environments. The organisation delivers end-to-end technical, operational, and workplace solutions, with a strong focus on safety, innovation, digital tools, and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Ensure high-quality, cost-efficient, and safe delivery of engineering and technical services across the site.
• Manage engineering service providers and suppliers in collaboration with procurement teams.
• Oversee infrastructure maintenance, utilities, and engineering operations, ensuring uninterrupted service delivery (24/7).
• Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Engineering SOPs, ensuring regular training and operational compliance.
• Support preventive maintenance programs using CMMS tools, ensuring data accuracy and asset reliability.
• Prepare and maintain long-term capital and infrastructure investment plans, aligned with site leadership priorities.
• Maintain clear ownership of critical systems (electrical, thermal, pressure systems, life safety).
• Support implementation of Health, Safety, Environment & Risk policies and ensure regulatory compliance.
• Contribute to technical delivery of capital projects and new technology deployments.
• Monitor and control engineering budgets, maintenance costs, and spare parts management.
• Identify and implement energy efficiency and cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality.
• Ensure compliance with statutory, internal, and client-specific quality and safety standards.
• Actively participate in audits, governance meetings, and quality assurance programs.
• Foster a strong "One Team" culture across employees, contractors, and client stakeholders.

• Strong technical background in building services engineering (HVAC, electrical, mechanical systems).
• Proven experience in technical operations, facilities management, or engineering leadership roles.
• Excellent leadership, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills.
• Ability to analyse data, assess risk, and translate insights into practical actions.
• Experience working in critical or high-availability environments.
• Strong safety mindset with hands-on knowledge of HS&E frameworks.
• Fluent in English, with good knowledge of Dutch or French.
• Comfortable working with digital tools such as BMS, CMMS, ticketing, and financial systems.
• Results-driven, proactive, and resilient, with a continuous improvement mindset.

The client is a leading B2B company committed to delivering high-quality products and innovative solutions to customers across multiple industries. By combining technical expertise, customer focus, and operational excellence, they help our clients improve their performance and achieve their business objectives.

Their success is built on long-term partnerships, a collaborative culture, and a passion for delivering value. They continuously invest in innovation, sustainability, and the development of their people to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving market.

Joining their team means becoming part of a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where initiative is encouraged, achievements are recognized, and career development is supported. They believe that their employees are their greatest asset and strive to create a workplace where everyone can grow, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact.

Jobomschrijving

They are looking for a proactive and customer-focused (Sr) Account Manager to join their growing commercial team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and developing a portfolio of B2B customers, building long-term relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

You will work closely with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that meet clients' business needs while contributing to the company's commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop a portfolio of existing B2B customers.
• Build strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers.
• Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Prepare and present commercial proposals tailored to customer needs.
• Negotiate contracts and pricing within company guidelines.
• Coordinate with internal departments (Customer Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance) to ensure seamless execution.
• Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively resolve issues.
• Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.
• Maintain accurate records and sales forecasts using the CRM system.
• Achieve and exceed sales targets and KPIs.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
• 3-7 years of experience in a B2B Account Management or Sales role.
• Proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset with a solution-driven approach.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Organized, autonomous, and results-driven.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, or similar) is an asset.
• Fluent in French, DUtch and English

Our client is a logistics trading company based in Breda.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you combine operational, commercial, and coordinating responsibilities within international ocean freight. You manage the full transport process from A to Z and act as the key link between internal teams and external partners. In addition, you lead a team and ensure structure, overview, and continuous process optimization.

The position is based in Breda, so you are willing to commute to this location on a daily basis.

Your Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate international deep-sea shipments (cross-trade)	
• Maintain contact and negotiate with shipping lines, forwarders, and suppliers	
• Book and follow up shipments until delivery	
• Manage and verify export documentation (B/Ls, L/Cs, Incoterms)	
• Analyze rates and optimize transport flows	
• Report to purchasing and sales teams	
• Lead and support a team (5 FTE)	
• Contribute to and implement improvements in operational processes

Your Profile
	
• 3 to 5 years of experience as a freight forwarder (deep sea), ready for the next step	
• Strong operational and commercial mindset	
• Experience with international transport within a trading environment is a plus	
• Good command of English (required); additional languages are an asset (Dutch not required)	
• Proactive, assertive, and strong communicator	
• Able to build relationships and identify opportunities	
• Strong organizational skills and sense of responsibility	
• Flexible mindset (willing to commute to Breda; international environment with multiple time zones)

Bier Central Brussels is the place where beer lovers can indulge their passion.

With 
over 300 beers on the menu, warm hospitality, and a kitchen that satisfies every appetite, we’re a staple in the heart of Brussels—just a stone’s throw from 
Brussels Central Station.
 

 
 

Our passionate team is looking for a 
new colleague (Flexi) who shares our enthusiasm and energy to join our bustling establishment.
 

 
 

As a server/bartender, you are the face of our business. You ensure that every guest feels welcome and enjoys 
smooth, friendly service.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Welcoming guests and guiding them to their table 

• Presenting the menu and providing additional explanations where necessary 

• Advising customers on their choice of food and drinks 

• Serving drinks and food 

• Clearing tables and ensuring a tidy environment 

• Helping to maintain general hygiene 

• Working in both the bar and the restaurant (no worries we’ll be happy to train you) 

We are looking for candidates who are 
willing to work hard, don’t like standing still, and are 
eager to work. 
 

 
 

-> 
Don't have that much 
experience in the hospitality industry yet? That's no problem—we'd be happy to teach you the ropes. As long as you're in 
good physical shape, there are plenty of opportunities.
 

 
 

Since we’re located in the heart of the capital, knowing a few 
languages is definitely helpful. The languages most commonly spoken here are 
Dutch, English, and French. It’s therefore no small advantage to be fluent in at least two of these languages.
 

 
 

Since closing time is around 11 p.m. to midnight, it’s convenient if you 
live nearby (i.e., within walking or biking distance, but not too dependent on public transportation—and definitely not on a car; parking in Brussels won’t make you any richer).

Groot Bijgaarden | Property Accountant | EN | Permanent Contract | Homeworking | 1113155

 

What you need to do now 
 
Interested in this varied role as Junior Property Accountant for a company based in Groot Bijgaarden? Apply quickly via the button below. For other opportunities within Junior Finance Support, you can contact Cato Vandenplas from Hays Brussels at 02/206.68.48.

 

 

Your new company 
 
Our client is an international service provider with a strong financial centre located in Groot Bijgaarden. The organisation is known for its professional approach, stable growth and continuous focus on efficiency and quality. To strengthen the Corporate Accounting team, they are looking for a Junior Property Accountant.

Your new role 
 
As a Junior Property Accountant, you support the Real Estate Accounting Expert and take ownership of a wide range of accounting tasks linked to development, construction and facility operations. You manage the daily administration of invoices and purchase orders, monitor real estate expenditure versus budget and ensure correct allocations and postings. You maintain the Fixed Asset register, prepare journal entries and reconciliation files, and contribute to monthly closings, financial statements and audit preparation. You collaborate closely with Real Estate teams and external service providers, resolve operational questions, support insurance claim handling and assist with ESG reporting, budgeting and M&A related activities. You also help improve accounting processes, support system rollouts and participate in European finance projects, ensuring accurate data, strong controls and efficient workflows.
 

 

Your profile 
 
For this position as Junior Property Accountant, we are looking for a candidate who:

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics or equivalent.
• Is a recent graduate or has initial accounting exposure.
• Has an excellent command of English; knowledge of French or German is a plus.
• Has a solid command of Excel; knowledge of SAP is an advantage.
• Has an initial understanding of Belgian or Luxembourg GAAP; basic IFRS knowledge is an additional asset.
• Has experience with fixed assets or multi country environments, which is considered a plus.
• Has an interest in digitalisation and enjoys working with modern financial systems.

As a cleanroom assistant you play a crucial role in the production process of advanced cell therapies. After extensive training in aseptic and GMP-compliant work, you and your colleagues will contribute to daily production activities following strict standard procedures.

As a cleanroom assistant you will be the person who ensures that day-to-day operations run smoothly and trouble-free within the cleanroom environment

• Supporting the aseptic and manual production process.

• Checking, maintaining, and cleaning equipment and materials.

• Ensuring proper transfer between different production zones.

• Adhering to established quality and safety standards to guarantee timely therapies for patients.

• A strong sense of responsibility and passion for healthcare.

• Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

• Accuracy and willingness to work in an aseptic environment with sterile clothing.

• An A2 diploma or equivalent experience – full training is provided.

• Willingness to work in several shifts and on weekends

• Good knowledge of English.

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders

Through the systematic monitoring of adherence to safety protocols and the provision of support during audit processes, the Safety Assistant makes a significant contribution to the establishment and preservation of a secure working environment, whilst facilitating the proactive identification and mitigation of potential safety hazards.
 

The Safety Assistant will be reporting to the Quality Manager.
 

Job Responsibilities
• Retrieve CCTV footage upon explicit request

• Conduct safety checks as prescribed by the BCAA

• Participate in incident investigations, prepare investigation reports, and develop

corrective actions in collaboration with operational management

• Follow up and implement safety procedures

• Monitor and address employees regarding safety practices

• Investigate aviation safety incidents

• Provide support during (safety) audits

• Assist in reporting incidents to the relevant authorities

• Take over tasks in the absence of QHSE

• Follows clearly prescribed internal and external safety rules (SOP/LOP)

• The position is primarily assigned to one station in Belgium, but the employee is

required to work at other stations when necessary

• Ensure compliance with safety rules

• Investigate and provide administrative follow-up on incidents

• Formal contact with external parties to ensure the execution and adherence to safety

rules

• Contact with all relevant internal parties to ensure the application of safety rules

• Contact with BCAA regarding deviations, incidents, questions, and reports

• Ensure compliance with environmental legislation and apply internal environmental

policies and procedures as part of daily responsibilities

• Safety driven
 

• Knowledge of BCAA and airport regulations
 

• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office
 

• Basic understanding of audits
 

• Flexibility in working hours, including occasional weekend and night shifts
 

• At least 12 months of experience in aviation
 

• Ability to communicate fluently (verbal and written) in French, Dutch, and English
 

• Ability to provide information and explain procedures

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365
• Fluent English and Dutch
